top_findings.title: ?author= filter never works over real HTTP (wrap-params middleware missing)
top_findings.evidence: src/book_api/core.clj:16,22 reads (get query-params "author") but core.clj:46-47 applies only wrap-json-body + wrap-json-response; ring.middleware.params/wrap-params is never required/applied, so over real HTTP query-params=nil and db/list-books returns ALL books. db.clj:12-15 filter is correct but unreachable; test core_test.clj:24 injects :query-params directly, masking the gap.
top_findings.suggestion: Require and apply ring.middleware.params/wrap-params (or wrap-query-params) in app; add a test driving the filter through :query-string.
